content:
We are pleased to invite you to submit presentation proposals for the FLoC 2026 Lean Workshop, which will be held in Lisbon, Portugal on 25 July 2026, as a satellite to the ITP conference.

Attending

As the workshop is affiliated with FLoC, attendees are required to register for the workshop.

Important dates

22 April 2026 (AoE): Abstract submission deadline

8 May 2026: Author notification

1 June 2026: FLoC early bird registration deadline for workshops

13 July 2026: FLoC registration deadline for workshops

25 July 2026: Lean Workshop

Submission instructions

We will be using a lightweight submission and review process. Talk proposals should take the form of a plaintext or markdown abstract (100-500 words).

Proposals can be for short talks (20 minutes) or long talks (30 minutes), and proposals should include your preferred length (but we may not be able to satisfy all requests).

Relevant subject matter includes but is not limited to:

  • Mathlib contributions and formalization stories
  • Teaching with Lean: pedagogical approaches and classroom experiences
  • Lean 4 metaprogramming: tactics, syntax, and automation
  • Software verification and program correctness using Lean
  • Proof engineering: structuring large formalizations
  • Community building and outreach initiatives
  • Lean in industry: experience reports and case studies

Submission: Submit your abstract to https://submissions.floc26.org/lean.

Program committee

  • María Inés de Frutos-Fernández (Universität Bonn)
  • Robert Y. Lewis (Brown University)
  • Bhavik Mehta (Imperial College London)
  • Kyle Miller (University of California, Santa Cruz)
  • Eric Wieser (Google DeepMind)

Organisers and contact

  • María Inés de Frutos-Fernández <midff@math.uni-bonn.de>
  • Kyle Miller <kymiller@ucsc.edu>

Dear all,
This is a reminder to submit your abstracts for the FLoC Lean workshop by 22 April 2026 (AoE). Looking forward to seeing many great talks in Lisbon!
